description: This file contains the implementation of LocalDiskShuffleMapOutputWriter, a class responsible for writing shuffle map output data to local disk in Apache Spark, including methods for partition writing, commit, abort, and cleanup.

classes.name: LocalDiskShuffleMapOutputWriter
classes.description: Main class responsible for writing shuffle data to local disk, managing partition writers, and handling commit and cleanup operations.

classes.name: LocalDiskShufflePartitionWriter
classes.description: Inner class that manages writing data for a specific shuffle partition, providing methods to open streams or channels and track bytes written.

classes.name: PartitionWriterStream
classes.description: Inner class extending OutputStream to write data to the output buffer, tracking the number of bytes written and ensuring proper closure.

classes.name: PartitionWriterChannel
classes.description: Inner class implementing WritableByteChannelWrapper to write data via FileChannel, tracking bytes written for a specific partition.

methods.name: getPartitionWriter
methods.description: Returns a writer for a specific reduce partition, initializing temporary files and tracking position.

methods.name: commitAllPartitions
methods.description: Finalizes writing, verifies file position, cleans up resources, and writes metadata for commit.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Handles aborting the write process, cleaning up temporary files.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Closes open streams and channels to release resources.

methods.name: initStream
methods.description: Initializes output stream with buffering for writing data.

methods.name: initChannel
methods.description: Initializes FileChannel for writing data, working around Linux kernel bugs.
